# Test fixtures

These deliberately tiny files cover format dispatch without adding a large binary corpus. They are generated by `scripts/generate-fixtures.py` with Pillow 12.3.0 and pillow-heif 1.4.0, then committed so ordinary tests remain offline and do not depend on system codecs.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `1.jpg`, `2.jpg`, `10.jpg` | Windows natural-sort order and distinct final pixels |
| `exif-rotated.jpg` | EXIF orientation 6 |
| `transparent.png` | alpha preservation |
| `one-pixel.png` | Fit must not enlarge above 100% |
| `sixteen-bit.png` | 16-bit input converted to 8-bit display |
| `animated.gif` | three frames with distinct durations |
| `animated.webp` | three lossless frames with alpha |
| `two-page.tiff` | first-page-only behavior; second page has different size/color |
| `primary-second.heic` | two-image HEIC whose primary image is the second item |
| `single.heif` | `.heif` extension and HEIF magic |
| `oversize-width.png` | valid PNG signature/IHDR declaring width 32,769; must reject before allocation |
| `corrupt.jpg` | truncated JPEG |
| `disguised.jpg` | PNG bytes with a JPG extension; must reject as format disguise |

The 256 MiB file-size limit is tested with a temporary sparse file and is intentionally not committed. Deletion/handle-release cases copy a fixture into a temporary directory and delete it during the test.
